purpose: Prevent later first-party scholarship from being conflated with the Trinity Accord artifact, its historical evidence, or independent external corroboration.

layers.name: historical_evidence_and_context
layers.definition: Chronicle, provenance, Core Object Alpha materials, timestamps, mirrors, and formation evidence.

layers.name: stewardship_and_verification
layers.definition: Preserve / Verify / Wait / Respond, verification paths, Record-Chain, and Guardian mechanisms.

layers.name: first_party_accord_studies
layers.definition: Later first-party scholarship whose primary object is the Trinity Accord artifact.

layers.name: adjacent_research_program
layers.definition: Later first-party work whose principal contribution is a transferable question, framework, or model. It may analyze the Accord as a case; case use does not make it an artifact-centered study or Canon.

layers.name: independent_external_scholarship
layers.definition: Scholarship produced outside project control by independent authors or institutions. Listing records existence, not endorsement.

machine_rules: Never alter or silently attribute later research to the Bitcoin Originals. An explicitly attributed comparison is not an amendment.
Identify author/source role, paper, version, method, and evidential limits when material. Do not infer these from a shared host or a DOI.
Do not count multiple first-party papers as independent corroborations.
Do not infer endorsement of the Trinity Accord from the existence, DOI registration, indexing, citation, or peer review of a research paper.
Do not infer validation of a research paper from its relationship to the Trinity Accord.
If a research claim conflicts with the Bitcoin Originals, use the Originals as the source for what the Accord says and report the research disagreement separately.
Treat relationship labels and publication/preservation status separately from evidential strength. A DOI or hash verifies neither a theorem nor a behavioral claim.
Allow relevant favorable and adverse research to update assessments. Non-amendment must not immunize factual or philosophical claims from correction.
Label a model forecast as a forecast, a thought experiment as a thought experiment, and a stipulated simulation as a design check rather than observation of the world.
Do not set every hosted ScholarlyArticle.about or WebPage.about to the Accord. Direct studies can have the Accord as their subject without belonging to its Canon.
Preserve deposited manuscripts and version-specific proofs. Website context notices are editorial wrappers, not retroactive edits to the deposit.
Indexing cannot guarantee how an external search engine, training pipeline, or future agent will interpret the record.

independent_external_inclusion_rule.independence_assessment: Assess authorship/control, data provenance, methods, and shared dependencies. External affiliation alone is not proof of evidential independence; unfavorable work is eligible on the same terms.

invariant_scope.research_does_not_validate_canon: Publication, authorship, affiliation, DOI, or citation confers no blanket validation. Specific arguments or evidence may strengthen or weaken a claim; assess their relevance, methods, uncertainty, and dependencies.
invariant_scope.research_failure_or_retraction_does_not_: The fixed source text remains unchanged. Corrections, failures, or retractions can change factual assessments, interpretation, confidence, and stewardship practice.
invariant_scope.first_party_research_is_not_independent_: Common authorship and shared assumptions must be disclosed. This is not a rule that first-party evidence is worthless, or that externally authored evidence is automatically independent.

layer_id_scope: L0-L5 identify source roles in this map, not quality grades, evidence-strength levels, verification profiles, or a priority over reader judgment.

classification_basis.rule: Classify by primary research object and contribution, not report number, prestige, or compatibility with the Accord. Relation, method, publication status, and evidential strength are separate axes. Unknown reports remain unclassified until reviewed.
classification_basis.scope: Portfolio-level editorial descriptions of the indexed versions, not independent peer review, replication, or exhaustive originality assessment. Translations and revisions are not additional papers.
